purpose: Preregister a cheap learned/structural gate that predicts whether the seeded-diverse start would win the one-stage commit before paying any seeded BDD compilation. This follows the negative width+1 gate holdout and is evaluated on a frozen disjoint n=14 test set after training only on n=12 graphs.

seeded_start.seed_base_rule: seeded candidate RNG seed = graph seed + 100000
seeded_start.eligibility: width <= min(natural_width, rcm_width)+2; if no eligible candidate choose minimum-width random candidate
seeded_start.choice: maximize minimum normalized Kendall distance to natural and RCM, ties by lower width then lexicographic order

label: 1 iff seeded has strictly lower one-stage live ROBDD nodes than both natural and RCM; ties are label 0 because fixed commit priority does not choose seeded on a tie.

model.degenerate_train_rule: if training labels contain only one class, use that constant prediction and record degeneracy rather than changing model or threshold

execution_policy.always_three: pay one local-search stage on natural, RCM and seeded, commit best by live nodes/candidate cost/fixed priority RCM-natural-seeded, then continue winner to at most 2 accepted moves total
execution_policy.learned_gate: compute all cheap features and model probability; if p>=0.5 pay seeded one-stage and use always-three, else use two-arm

local_search.selection: min live then allocated then lexicographic

cost_accounting.primary: BDD candidate compilations paid by test policy
cost_accounting.predictor_cost: report feature extraction + logistic inference wall-ms separately; seeded permutation/width/Kendall generation is always charged to feature extraction even when gate closes
cost_accounting.training_cost: report separately and do not subtract from per-test deployment cost

predeclared_tests: Report training label prevalence, test seeded-winner prevalence, classifier confusion matrix and AUROC only if both test classes exist.
Primary system comparison: learned_gate vs always_three on summed final live nodes and summed BDD candidate compilations across all 16 test graphs.
Secondary: learned_gate vs two_arm. Report every false negative with its quality regret and every false positive with wasted BDD compilations.
All completed endpoints must match exhaustive truth bitset and Hamming-rank oracle.
No threshold/model/feature changes after outcomes. Any revision requires a new untouched test split.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering. This tests a cheap start-arm inclusion predictor, not general BDD variable ordering or proof utility.
